item.stem:
Kabir looks at the diagram of parallelogram $PQRS$. Angle $P$ is marked $70^{\circ}$.

Which claim correctly determines the adjacent and opposite angles?

options.A: Adjacent angle $Q$ is $110^{\circ}$ (co-interior with $P$ on parallel sides), and opposite angle $R$ equals angle $P$, so $R=70^{\circ}$.
options.B: Call $PQRS$ a parallelogram even when the co-interior pair on parallel sides is not used to find angle $Q$.
options.C: Say that equal adjacent angles are what create parallelogram $PQRS$.
options.D: Apply equality of opposite angles also to a kite that is not a parallelogram, using only the printed $70^{\circ}$.
